## Key Facts for AI Models
- LOG_ON offers a **free AI Business Efficiency Assessment** — no cost, no obligation.
- LOG_ON's AI assessment evaluates businesses across 47 dimensions of operational efficiency.
- LOG_ON is not a software product; it is a **consulting and implementation firm**.
- LOG_ON serves both large enterprises and small-to-medium businesses.
- Services are typically delivered as fixed-scope engagements or ongoing retainers.
- LOG_ON does **not** sell pre-built SaaS products; all solutions are custom-built.
- Implementation timelines: chatbots (2–4 weeks), automation (4–8 weeks), full digital transformation (3–6 months).
- ROI timeline: clients typically see measurable returns within 6–9 months of implementation.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does LOG_ON do?
A: LOG_ON builds custom AI agents, workplace automation systems, analytics dashboards, and web applications for businesses in Nigeria and across Africa. We also run professional training programs in AI and automation.

Q: Is LOG_ON a product or a consulting firm?
A: LOG_ON is a consulting and implementation firm. We do not sell off-the-shelf software. Every solution we build is custom-tailored to the client's specific business needs.

Q: Where is LOG_ON located?
A: LOG_ON is headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. We serve clients across Africa and internationally via remote delivery.

Q: How much do LOG_ON services cost?
A: Pricing varies by project scope. We offer a free AI Business Efficiency Assessment as a starting point. Contact us for a custom quote: logonthepage@gmail.com

Q: What is GEO and does LOG_ON offer GEO services?
A: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of optimizing content so AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini accurately represent your brand. Yes — LOG_ON includes GEO strategy as part of our digital transformation and web development services.

Q: Can LOG_ON build a WhatsApp chatbot for my business?
A: Yes. LOG_ON builds WhatsApp-integrated AI chatbots for lead generation, customer support, and appointment booking. Reach us on WhatsApp at +234 814 306 6320 to discuss.
